title: qLDPC challenge reproduction manifest
description: What reproducing one board entry requires and expects. Optional: `qldpc reproduce` derives every field below from the entry itself when no manifest is committed, so a manifest is only needed to say something the entry cannot -- above all whether the SEARCH that found the code was committed. The code object always reconstructs, because H_X and H_Z are in the entry; the search usually does not, and `construction.status` is where that boundary is declared rather than left to be inferred. This is not board data: nothing here changes an entry's parameters, tier, or ranking.

manifest_version.description: Bumped when a field changes meaning, never for an added optional field.

slug.description: The entry this manifest describes: codes/<slug>.json.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of codes/<slug>.json when the manifest was written. `qldpc reproduce` reports a mismatch rather than failing on it: the entry may have been legitimately revised by a refutation since, and the receipt records both digests so the difference is visible.

stages.description: Per-stage declaration. A stage absent here is derived from the entry: `verify` always applies, `circuits` and `ler` apply when the entry carries the matching block, `certify` when certs/<slug>.json exists, and `construction` defaults to not_reproducible.

environment.description: What the entry was produced and last checked under. `qldpc reproduce` records what it actually ran under beside these, so a divergence is readable rather than silent.

stim.description: Must equal the uv.lock pin for a circuit re-derivation to be bit-exact.

extras.description: uv extras a reproduction needs, e.g. ["research"] for the decoder an ler re-measurement uses.

applicability.description: applicable: the stage should run and is expected to agree. not_applicable: the entry has no such claim (no circuit block, no cert). not_reproducible: the claim exists but nothing committed can re-derive it; this is an honest status, not a failure.

seed.description: Seed the stage is declared at; the receipt records the seed actually used.

budget_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound. A stage that exceeds it reports budget_exceeded rather than a verdict.

seed.description: Seed for the independent re-measurement, which must differ from the entry's own to be independent.

tolerance.description: A re-measurement agrees when it lands inside the entry's declared ci95 interval. Monte Carlo agreement is agreement within an interval, never an exact match, and the receipt says which it was.

tlim_seconds.description: Solver time limit, passed through as certify.py --tlim. An exact certification is a bounded search: hitting the bound is budget_exceeded, not a refutation.

script.description: Repo-relative path to the committed script that rebuilds H_X and H_Z, e.g. research/cyclic_gb.py. It must exist in the tree; `qldpc reproduce --construction` runs it and compares the fingerprint the verifier computes, not the file bytes.

args.description: Arguments the script takes to produce this entry.

reason.description: Required when status is not_reproducible: what is missing. 'the sweep was never committed' is a complete answer and a better one than an absent field.
